verdict.rationale: Salesmate documents its own AI agents that "update CRM records, fields, and activities autonomously," support next-best actions, and summarize conversations. It also offers public RESTful APIs, so an agent-driven record-update path exists in thin form. Nothing ties this specifically to deal-stage changes driven by email or meeting signals, no MCP server is evidenced, and probes found no machine-readable API spec. Missing for 10: documented deal-stage and next-step update endpoints, explicit email/meeting-signal-driven stage updates, an official MCP server, accessible API reference/OpenAPI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent update deal stages and next steps from email and meeting signals via the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Update CRM records, fields, and activities autonomously without manual intervention
summarize conversations, automate repetitive work, support next-best actions
Access to publicly available RESTful APIs
